# Reviewing requests & insights

The **Requests** page is your steady-state workspace once a trust center is live.

## Recommendations (the approval agent)

Every pending request shows an automated **recommendation** - `recommend approve`,
`review`, or `caution` - with the reasons behind it. The engine is deterministic and
combines:

- CRM relationship (existing customer in HubSpot/Salesforce → strong positive; no match
  → caution)
- a contract uploaded as proof of agreement
- NDA acceptance
- the auto-approve domain allowlist

It's advisory: you (or an agent) still click approve. Approving mints a scoped, expiring
key; you can **limit it to specific artifacts** at approval time.

## Issued keys & history

- **Issued keys** lists every active/revoked key with scope, expiry, and last-used time -
  revoke any of them instantly.
- **History** shows past decisions (granted/denied), whether they were **auto** (and via
  which policy) or **manual**, and when.

## Insights

The **Insights** page aggregates your audit log into a request funnel
(pending/granted/denied/auto), active vs revoked keys, total reads, **most-read
artifacts**, **most active readers**, and recent activity - so you can see how your
evidence is actually being consumed. Export the raw log as CSV/JSON from **Audit log**.
